summary: Xylem Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered public offering of $1 billion in senior notes, comprising $500 million of 5.200% notes due 2033 and $500 million of 5.450% senior blue notes due 2036. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing unsubordinated debt. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, with proceeds from the blue notes allocated to eligible blue projects. The offering is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event.
